description: Void-owned decisions for high-impact theme near-color pairs. Keep this file in sync with scripts/audit-theme-colors.mjs output; lower the baseline when a pair is merged.

decisions.reason: The neutral pair is currently shared by app shell, markdown, Flow Chat, and component-library surfaces. It is a known near pair rather than a stray feature color.
decisions.reevaluateWhen: Revisit when the base dark neutral ramp is consolidated across app shell and component-library tokens.

decisions.reason: Workspace media, preview, markdown, and automation surfaces use these light neutrals for different readable surface roles. The distinction should remain until light-theme visual review proves it redundant.
decisions.reevaluateWhen: Revisit after light-theme screenshots cover workspace media, media preview, Flow Chat history, and generated-widget surfaces.

decisions.reason: Adjacent light text and component states currently cross component-library controls and theme presets. The pair needs a token-ramp decision before it can be merged safely.
decisions.reevaluateWhen: Revisit when component-library text roles are mapped to a single semantic light ramp.

decisions.reason: The pair is localized to Mermaid theme rendering and should be reviewed with diagram readability before consolidation.
decisions.reevaluateWhen: Revisit after Mermaid editor themes are audited against app-wide light neutral tokens.
